title: Incremental Progress Trap
setup: Returning from Hermit emptied. Resolution phase needing to consolidate gains. Advisor teaches stacking small wins—incremental progress compounding. But each win creates dependency on next win. Eight of Disks stacking weaponized as addiction-to-progress ensuring burnout when wins stop.
description: Resolution consolidating. Small wins stacking addiction creating. Eight disks stacked precariously falling when wins pause. Learns accepting plateaus—no progress periods sustainable. Resolution via plateau-peace not win-stacking.
narrativeFunction: Shows win-stacking weaponized as progress-addiction. Resolution requiring plateau-acceptance over incremental momentum.
focus: Win-stacking weaponized. Plateau acceptance. Consequence: no-progress-peace culture.
beat_goal: Francisco accepts plateaus—recognizing win-stacking addictive, choosing sustainable no-progress periods.
symbolism: Eight disks stacked precariously. Flat plateau stable.
sensoryDetail: Stacking wins exhaustingly—each requiring next, addiction to progress. Francisco plateauing: accepting no-wins periods, sustainable flatness. Eight disks unst acked flatly.
internalConflict: Wanting progress, facing addiction. Choosing plateau-peace over win-stacking momentum.
characterGrowthElement: Learning progress weaponized. Defensive wisdom: plateau acceptance, no-wins sustainability. Eight disks: flat not stacked.
seriesConnectionResonance: Plateau acceptance ongoing. No-progress peace valued.

title: Loss Accounting Horror
setup: Plateau peaceful but avoiding losses. Consultant teaches loss-tracking—learning from failures stacking. But accounting losses creates depression-spiral. Eight disks stacking losses burying under weight. Loss-stacking weaponized as guaranteed demoralization.
description: Plateau sustainable but loss-avoidant. Loss-tracking creating depression-spiral. Eight loss-disks crushing. Learns loss-amnesia—forgetting failures, accepting ignorance over demoralization. Resolution via strategic forgetting.
narrativeFunction: Shows loss-tracking weaponized as demoralization. Resolution requiring strategic amnesia over learning-from-failure.
saveTheCatBeat: Resolution deepening - loss-tracking crushing forcing amnesia
focus: Loss-stacking weaponized. Strategic forgetting. Consequence: amnesia-grace culture.
beat_goal: Francisco accepts amnesia—recognizing loss-tracking crushing, choosing strategic forgetting over failure-learning.
sensoryDetail: Tracking losses spiraling—depression deepening, weight crushing. Francisco forgetting: strategic amnesia, grace over learning. Loss-disks forgotten lightening.
internalConflict: Wanting to learn, facing crushing weight. Choosing amnesia over failure-tracking despite feeling irresponsible.
characterGrowthElement: Learning loss-stacking weaponized. Defensive wisdom: strategic amnesia, forgetting-grace. Eight disks: forgotten not stacked.
seriesConnectionResonance: Strategic amnesia ongoing. Forgetting valued. Loss-tracking rejected.

title: Mastery Monotony
setup: Plateau plus amnesia sustainable but unmotivated. Guide teaches mastery-stacking—skill development compounding. But mastery creates boredom—expertise monotonous. Eight disks mastered stacking into tedious expertise. Mastery weaponized as boredom-guarantee.
description: Sustainable but unmotivated. Mastery stacking boring. Eight mastery-disks tedious. Learns deliberate mediocrity—maintaining competence avoiding expertise  boredom. Resolution via good-enough not mastery.
narrativeFunction: Shows mastery weaponized as boredom. Resolution requiring deliberate mediocrity over expertise-stacking.
saveTheCatBeat: Resolution culminating - mastery boring forcing mediocrity
focus: Mastery weaponized. Deliberate mediocrity. Consequence: good-enough culture.
beat_goal: Francisco completes Stack Wins/Losses via mediocrity—recognizing mastery boring, choosing good-enough over expertise.
symbolism: Eight mastery-disks tediously perfect. Mediocre disks lively.
timelineSignificance: Mastery weaponized. Mediocrity accepted. Stack complete.
sensoryDetail: Mastering skills tediously—expertise boring, monotony crushing. Francisco mediocrity: good-enough competence, avoiding mastery boredom. Disks competent lively not perfect tedious.
internalConflict: Wanting excellence, facing boredom. Choosing mediocre-liveliness over mastery-monotony.
characterGrowthElement: Completing Stack: wins→plateau, losses→amnesia, mastery→mediocrity. Resolution via flat forgetting good-enough. Eight disks: plateaued forgotten mediocre not stacked.
seriesConnectionResonance: Deliberate mediocrity ongoing. Good-enough valued. Mastery rejected.

title: Eight Disks Scattered
setup: Stack Wins/Losses complete: plateaued forgotten mediocre. Eight of Disks realized—not stacked but scattered. Resolution via dispersion not accumulation. Win-momentum, loss-learning, mastery-development all rejected. Eight disks lying separately flat—plateaued progress, amnesia-forgotten losses,  mediocre competence. Resolution complete via scattering not stacking.
description: Stack complete via scattering. Eight disks dispersed—plateaued forgotten mediocre. Resolution achieved through non-accumulation. Wins/losses/mastery all scattered separately. Eight disks flat not stacked complete.
narrativeFunction: Completes Stack Wins/Losses via complete scattering. Eight disks dispersed not accumulated. Resolution through dispersion.
focus: Stacking completely rejected. Dispersion. Consequence: scattered-not-accumulated culture.
chapterSceneFocus: Eight Disks Scattered celebrates dispersion resolution
beat_goal: Francisco completes Resolution via scattering—eight disks dispersed plateaued forgotten mediocre not stacked.
symbolism: Eight of Disks fully realized: scattered separately not stacked. Dispersion resolution.
timelineSignificance: Stack complete via scattering. Eight disks dispersed. Resolution achieved.
sensoryDetail: Eight disks scattered—plateaued progress flat, forgotten losses absent, mediocre competence good-enough. Not stacked accumulating but dispersed separately. Resolution via scattering not consolidation. Complete.
internalConflict: Accepting scattering resolution. Recognizing: all stacking weaponized, resolution via dispersion not accumulation.
characterGrowthElement: Completing Stack: all accumulation weaponized (wins addictive, losses crushing, mastery boring), resolution via scattering. Eight disks mastered: dispersed separately plateaued forgotten mediocre. Resolution complete through non-consolidation.
seriesConnectionResonance: Scattered resolution Books 5-9. Dispersion valued. Accumulation rejected. Eight disks dispersed permanently.
